quoted.text:
Ja'Kobi Lane continues to get rave reviews from training camp for the Ravens. He is not a full route-tree separator, but as I wrote in the profile, he can win on some out-breakers and truly has tractor-beam hands. We have, without a doubt, seen a lot of the latter in the camp highlights. Even if you're skeptical, there's no denying that ability. 

Overall, still need to see more but that ability at the catch point and a true X profile is something this team has lacked. Don't be shocked if he is at least the WR3 and the primary X in 11 personnel for this team early.
